project.dialog.title: Choose your codebase folder
project.card.name: {repo} · {copy}
project.create.detail.noSession: The agent wasn’t running in this copy.
project.create.detail.noServer: Onlook couldn’t find your app running.
project.create.detail.neverOpened: The project did not open in this tab, so the agent was not asked to start the app.
project.create.next.planning: Make sure the folder hasn’t moved, then click Retry.
project.create.next.copying: Check the details below, then click Retry to try copying the folder again.
project.create.copy.ignored_files: Every file in this folder is excluded by Git ignore rules. Update the folder’s .gitignore or your global Git ignore rules, then choose the folder again.
project.create.copy.permission_denied: Onlook couldn’t read or write a file. Check the folder’s permissions and Onlook’s access in System Settings, then choose the folder again.
project.create.copy.folder_unavailable: A file or folder is no longer available. Check that the folder is still there and any cloud files are downloaded, then choose it again.
project.create.copy.copy_in_progress: Another copy or an unfinished copy is using this folder. Wait for any other copy to finish. If none is running, quit and reopen Onlook, then choose the folder again.
project.create.copy.disk_full: There isn’t enough disk space to copy this folder. Free up space, then choose the folder again.
project.create.copy.git_timed_out: Git took too long to copy this folder and was stopped. Check that the folder is available, then click Retry.
project.create.copy.git_failed: Git couldn’t prepare the copy. Check the details below and fix the Git issue, then choose the folder again.
project.create.next.installing: To run the install again, click Retry.
project.create.next.starting: To start the app again, click Retry.
project.install.managerMissing: Onlook couldn’t find {manager}. Install it or make it available in your shell, then click Retry. You can keep working in chat.
